data.narrative:
Emerald AI is a seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Varun Sivaram that has raised $68M to date. The valuation universe comprises nine peers in the Climate & Energy sector, including five notable private companies (Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen) and one public reference point (Lonza, ticker LNZA). However, the peer set lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables—zero seed-stage peers and zero adjacent-stage peers meeting valuation-tier criteria—making a traditional peer-median approach inapplicable.

Valuation analysis relies on stage-progression methodology, which applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage funding rounds to the $68M raised proxy, yielding an implied value of $170M. This method assumes the company will achieve standard venture milestones justifying the step-up multiplier applied to subsequent financing.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $144M to $195M, with a median of $170M. The narrow methodological basis reflects the scarcity of direct peer comparables at the same stage and valuation tier, which represents the primary source of uncertainty. Additional diligence on comparable funding rounds, revenue trajectory if applicable, and capital efficiency relative to the broader climate-tech cohort would strengthen conviction in this range.
